message:
The other day, we were chatting about our emergency plans—when I suddenly realized I didn’t even know where our family’s important documents were! After a quick scavenger hunt, it turns out our ‘go-bag’ was more of a ‘go-bag-of-miscellaneous-stuff’—you know, the one with old toys and half-eaten snacks. 

We all have those moments that remind us we’re not as prepared as we think, and honestly, it made us laugh. It’s a gentle nudge to check in on our plans and make sure we’re ready for whatever may come our way. 

How about you—when was the last time you checked your own ‘go-bag’? 😄
